The actual download and extraction happen inside the `package()` function, which is not executed during `--printsrcinfo`. Therefore, merely sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction poses no risk of unintended code execution or data exfiltration.

This file adheres to standard AUR packaging patterns and contains no malicious logic in its global scope.
